page: City page: B2B lead generation Abu Dhabi (/b2b-lead-generation-abu-dhabi)

items.question: Does Myntmore have an office in Abu Dhabi?
items.answer: No. Myntmore is based in BKC, Mumbai, and runs every engagement remotely. Mumbai is 1.5 hours ahead of the UAE, so our working days overlap almost entirely, and UAE clients work with us over calls, shared dashboards and a weekly report.

items.question: How is outreach in Abu Dhabi different from Dubai?
items.answer: Abu Dhabi has fewer, larger buyers, many of them government-linked groups with formal procurement. That favours account-based outreach to a defined list of companies and several roles in each, rather than high-volume cold email. Dubai suits higher volumes across more, smaller companies.

items.question: Which Abu Dhabi buyers is this built for?
items.answer: Suppliers to energy, industrial and infrastructure groups, healthcare and life sciences companies, and IT, fintech and professional services firms selling into ADGM, Hub71 and the wider capital. The system adapts to any B2B ICP.

items.question: Can outreach get us onto a vendor list or a tender?
items.answer: Outreach does not replace vendor registration or a tender response. What it does is start conversations with the people who own a requirement, so that when registration or a tender opens, they already know you.

items.question: Can you help an Indian company find clients in Abu Dhabi?
items.answer: Yes. We build separate sending infrastructure, write copy that reads as native to UAE buyers and send in their working hours. Our UAE campaigns include managed IT services, employee benefits insurance and pharma distribution partners.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days. Most clients see their first qualified conversations within 3 to 4 weeks of kickoff, once ICP mapping, list building, and sequence setup are complete.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract.

items.question: What do you need from us to get started?
items.answer: A clear picture of your ICP (even a rough one works), access to a domain we can set up for outbound sending, and about an hour of your time for an onboarding call. We handle ICP refinement, list building, sequence writing, and day-to-day campaign management from there.
